title: Class-II gauge-horizontal source, joint source-potential, translation-model reduction, and obstruction boundary
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and A10-A13 strict sharp cubes, exact Class-II algebra and independently executed fixtures close several invalid proof architectures without closing the Nelson theorem. v1.1 fixes the factor-four allocation, proves exact equivalence of the one-use target to the open q=10/9 Nelson moment, and refutes endpoint-only timewise Young and the direct one-shot Ramer map by a production determinant fold. The translation-model continuation proves the flexible sufficient field range epsilon_6<gamma/6, with the stress choice epsilon_6=0.15, delta=0.06, epsilon_v=0.45 leaving sextic margin 0.06. It also proves the exact finite-cutoff translation/frame identities, deterministic-shift expectation positivity, and the Cartan current identity. A uniform deterministic constant remainder is refuted, but an integrable random remainder is not. The sole canonical gate remains the umbrella one-use theorem; its selected subordinate gate is A13-CLASSII-CAMERON-MARTIN-TRANSLATED-CURRENT-MODEL-LIFT, requiring universal centered derivative-square tensors, coefficient jets, L3-level moments, translation continuity, and no new interaction counterterm.
scope: PROVED-STRUCTURAL-TRANSLATION-REDUCTIONS-AND-EXECUTED-ARCHITECTURE-NOGOS@FIXED-FLOOR-SHARP-CUBE on L=16 for the A1 production symbol and coefficients, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, exact Fourier products, common real-even finite sharp regulators, exact A7 covariance subtraction, and the A10-A13 dyadic rectangular-cube filtration. The Fierz, Gaussian, Hardy, flexible potential, exact translation/frame, deterministic expectation, Cartan, one-use/Nelson equivalence, nonfrozen Schatten-two, coefficient-curl, conditional Carleman-Fredholm, and predictable triangular determinant results are analytic. The degree-65536 carrier, 30-real-mode Ramer singularity, and manufactured finite-grid identities are independently reproduced executed evidence rather than interval or continuum proofs. The random/adapted translation estimate, translated model lift, and umbrella one-use gate remain open.
falsifier: A failure of the compact Fierz matrix, shell commutator, shifted-Gaussian identity, source-doubling fixtures, factor-four correction, exact one-use/Nelson equivalence, scalar loop polynomial, nonfrozen Schatten decomposition, coefficient-curl formula, corrected t=q/2 Ramer normalization, either production determinant sign-change route, flexible potential equality, exact translation/frame or Cartan identity, deterministic expectation formula, sharp-cube deterministic-remainder fixture, translated-model moment arithmetic, either independent implementation, source hashes, PDF QA, assertion count, or release gate falsifies this package.

reproduction.expected: Primary 29/29, non-importing independent 24/24, and integrated aggregate 106/106 pass; A13-CLASSII-TRANSLATION-MODEL-REDUCTION-INTEGRATED-PASS; exit 0.

no_overclaim: This claim does not prove a cutoff-uniform estimate for random or adapted translations, a uniform translated-model Lp bound, the controlled-shell estimate, the equivalent q=10/9 Nelson moment, failure of every nonlinear Gaussian transport, the A11 stabilised theorem or A7 Nelson bound, a full joint log-Laplace bound, an interacting measure, absence of new interaction counterterms, floor or regulator removal, infinite volume, a phase transition or BCC selection, or T5, T6, or T7. Deterministic-shift positivity does not extend automatically to adapted shifts, finite-grid identities are algebraic regression rather than continuum estimates, and the Ramer singularity refutes only the one-shot u=(5/9)b map.
next_action: Prove A13-CLASSII-CAMERON-MARTIN-TRANSLATED-CURRENT-MODEL-LIFT under the umbrella A13-CLASSII-CONTROLLED-SHELL-ENERGY-ONE-USE objective. Construct the universal centered derivative-square tensor, area, QX, and QXX coefficient jets with at least L3-level model-norm moments, Cameron-Martin translation continuity, and no new divergent interaction counterterm. Then prove a strict-past signed conditional reconstruction that keeps the positive square, centered Q, current, and Cartan curvature coupled, followed by a cutoff-uniform expected random-remainder form bound. Termwise paraproduct Young, Boue-Dupuis/HJB recasting, coefficient-one local conditioning, finite-bank Bellman repair, endpoint-only timewise Young, repeated past-energy payment, resolvent-only repair, and the one-shot u=(5/9)b Ramer map are forbidden.
